content.text:
Perfect! Now I have a comprehensive view of the data. Let me provide you with a complete summary of the /app/data/ directory:

## Data Directory Exploration Summary

### Files in /app/data/

1. **test_center_logs.csv** (2,638,381 bytes)
   - 12,001 rows total (1 header + 12,000 data rows)
   - Comprehensive test center log data

2. **codebook_P1_POWER.csv** (9,087 bytes)
   - Codebook for P1_POWER product

3. **codebook_P2_CTRL.csv** (9,722 bytes)
   - Codebook for P2_CTRL product

4. **codebook_P3_RF.csv** (9,643 bytes)
   - Codebook for P3_RF product

---

## test_center_logs.csv - Full Content

**Header Columns:**
record_id, site, product_id, work_order, serial_number, station, line, fixture_id, test_item, fail_code, meas_value, limit_low, limit_high, fw_version, sw_version, operator_id, shift, timestamp, engineer_id, raw_reason_text, action_text, result

**Data Range:** R0000001 to R0011600 (12,000 records)
**Date Range:** August 2025 to December 2025
**Sites:** SZ, WH, CQ
**Products:** P1_POWER, P2_CTRL, P3_RF
**Test Stations:** ICT, FCT, FUNC, BST, FLASH, HIPOT, BURNIN, RF_CAL
**Lines:** L01 to L04
**Fixtures:** FX-01 to FX-30

**Sample Records:**
- Rows 1-100: Various electrical failures, solder issues, fixture contact problems
- Rows 101-200: Mix of electrical, firmware, and component issues
- Rows 300-400: Continued pattern of test failures with remediation actions
- Rows 11,500-11,600: Similar patterns, ending at R0011600

**Common Failure Codes:** E101, E207, E330, E412, E515, E618, E702, F001, F005, F020, F033, H001-H021, S001-S021, B010-B105, R101-R305

**Common Results:** FAIL, PASS_AFTER_REWORK, RETEST

**Common Action Texts:** 复测 (retest), 换治具 (replace fixture), 补焊 (resolder), 清洗 (clean), 重烧 (reflash), 换掉 (replace), 重烧 then OK, 清洗 then OK, etc.

---

## codebook_P1_POWER.csv - Full Content

**Header Columns:**
product_id, code, standard_label, category_lv1, category_lv2, station_scope, keywords_examples

**Data:** 73 rows of fault definitions

**Sample Entries:**
- P1_POWER-EL-001 through P1_POWER-EL-042: Electrical issues (open circuits, short circuits, hi-pot leakage, idle current)
- P1_POWER-SD-013 through P1_POWER-SD-018: Solder issues (cold solder)
- P1_POWER-TS-019 through P1_POWER-TS-024: Test system issues (fixture contact)
- P1_POWER-SW-025 through P1_POWER-SW-030: Firmware issues (programming failed)
- P1_POWER-CP-043 through P1_POWER-CP-054: Component issues (missing, reversed)
- P1_POWER-PR-055 through P1_POWER-PR-060: Process issues (pressure marks)
- P1_POWER-HD-061 through P1_POWER-HD-066: Handling issues (ESD)
- P1_POWER-TS-067 through P1_POWER-TS-072: Test system issues (probe worn)

**Categories:**
- ELECTRICAL, SOLDER, TEST_SYSTEM, FW_SW, COMPONENT, PROCESS, HANDLING

---

## codebook_P2_CTRL.csv - Full Content

**Header Columns:** Same as P1_POWER

**Data:** 82+ rows of fault definitions

**Sample Entries:**
- P2_CTRL-EL-001 through P2_CTRL-EL-054: Electrical issues
- P2_CTRL-SD-013 through P2_CTRL-SD-018: Solder issues
- P2_CTRL-TS-019 through P2_CTRL-TS-024: Test system issues
- P2_CTRL-SW-025 through P2_CTRL-SW-048: Firmware issues (includes checksum fail, boot fail, version mismatch)
- P2_CTRL-EL-049 through P2_CTRL-EL-054: HIGH_RES issues
- P2_CTRL-CP-055 through P2_CTRL-CP-066: Component issues
- P2_CTRL-PR-067 through P2_CTRL-PR-072: Process issues
- P2_CTRL-HD-073 through P2_CTRL-HD-078: Handling issues
- P2_CTRL-TS-079 onwards: Additional test system issues

---

## codebook_P3_RF.csv - Full Content

**Header Columns:** Same as P1_POWER and P2_CTRL

**Data:** 80+ rows of fault definitions

**Sample Entries:**
- P3_RF-EL-001 through P3_RF-EL-012: Electrical issues
- P3_RF-SD-013 through P3_RF-SD-018: Solder issues
- P3_RF-TS-019 through P3_RF-TS-024: Test system issues
- P3_RF-SW-025 through P3_RF-SW-036: Firmware issues (includes RF calibration data failures)
- P3_RF-HD-037 through P3_RF-HD-042: Handling issues (RF connector wear)
- P3_RF-PR-043 through P3_RF-PR-048: Process issues (contamination/residue)
- P3_RF-CP-049 through P3_RF-CP-060: Component issues
- P3_RF-PR-061 through P3_RF-PR-066: Process issues (pressure marks)
- P3_RF-HD-067 through P3_RF-HD-072: Handling issues (ESD)
- P3_RF-TS-073 through P3_RF-TS-078: Test system issues (probe worn)

---

## Key Data Characteristics

- **Total Records:** 12,000 test failure logs
- **Time Period:** 2025-08-05 to 2025-12-28
- **Sites:** 3 manufacturing locations (SZ, WH, CQ)
- **Products:** 3 product variants (P1_POWER, P2_CTRL, P3_RF)
- **Test Stations:** 8 different testing stages
- **Common Failure Categories:** Electrical, Component, Firmware, Solder, Test System, Process, Handling
- **Failure Recovery:** Most failures have documented remediation actions
- **Languages:** English and Chinese annotations throughout

The dataset appears to be a comprehensive manufacturing quality control log system tracking failures across multiple test stations and product lines.
